title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (11/20): The Annual Checkup
note_en: 被 marks the passive: 他被告知大部分结果都正常 "he was told that most of the results were normal." Unlike English, where "was told" is completely neutral, Chinese 被 traditionally leans toward things that happen to you, and it is used far less often than the English passive; formal verbs like 告知 ("inform") are one place where it sounds natural.
